senses.gloss: pr. n. m.ʿIyya, dialectic pronunciation of חִיָּיא.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 16b:2">M. Kat. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>אמר ליה ע׳ וכ׳</he> he (Rabbi, being angry with R. Ḥiyyah) said to him, Iyya, who calls thee outside? <cite ref="Keritot 8a:11">Ker. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>צריכין לדברי ע׳</he> they still need the interpretation of Iyya (of whom you spoke so contemptuously as ‘the Babylonian’).
